BiblicalUsage: Chagav is a cleft, a rift in the rocks. The beloved is called a dove in the clefts of the rock, and the prophets use the same picture against Edom — you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, your pride has deceived you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cleft of the rock holds two opposite people: the dove who hides there in love, and the proud man who hides there in pride. The rock is the same; the heart is different.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
